segments.text: Okay, Quill planning. Just us two, so let's be quick. Newsletter, CMS, launch post.
Coffee first. Okay. Go.
Newsletter cadence. I want weekly. Thursdays, because that's when open rates peaked on the old list.
Weekly is a lot for two people.
It's one essay and three links. You write the essay every other week, I do the alternate ones.
Fine. Thursdays.
Decision: the newsletter goes out weekly on Thursdays. Rationale, the old list's open rates.
CMS. Ghost or Substack?
Ghost. We own the list, newsletters are built in, and the blog can live on the same thing. Substack owns your audience.
Agreed. Decision: the CMS is Ghost. Rationale, we own the subscriber list and newsletters are built in.
How big is the list, actually?
About two thousand subscribers, migrated from the old one.
Launch post. Omar, that's yours. When?
The draft is half done. Launch post published by Tuesday the 22nd.
The 22nd. It needs legal to look at the pricing paragraph.
I'll send it to them Friday.
And I'll finish the style guide by Tuesday the 15th, so your draft and mine sound like one person.
Please. Our commas disagree.
One more. The October issues. I want to do interviews instead of essays, four of them, people who actually run small newsrooms.
I like it. Who?
I have a list of eight. I'll narrow it down after the launch post, I can't do both at once.
Fine. Decision: October is an interview month, four interviews instead of essays.
Weekly sync, Wednesdays at ten?
Wednesdays. Fine.
Decision: the editorial sync is Wednesdays at ten.
Done. Thursdays, Ghost, launch post the 22nd, style guide the 15th, interviews in October.
Back to the draft.
